component.name: Simple Audio Sweeper
component.summary: DUDE (Duplicates Detector). A GUI utility for finding duplicated files, delete or link them to save space.

description.p: Duplicates Detector is a cross-platform GUI utility for finding duplicate files, allowing you to delete or link them to save space. Duplicate files are displayed and processed on two synchronized panels for efficient and convenient operation.

ul.li: Scanning for duplicate files in multiple designated folders (up to 8)
Support for regular expressions or glob expressions syntax
